191672: Akari Watanabe is a Gyaru who was assigned to be Jirou Yakuin's partner during the marriage practical, a special course to train students how to function in a real romantic relationship, despite her wanting to be partnered with Minami Tenjin, her true fool love.
191673: Jirou Yakuin is the main protagonist, being an antisocial, pessimistic high school boy. He ends up forced to pair with Akari Watanabe in their school's "Couple Practical" course, despite harboring feelings for his childhood friend Shiori Sakurazaka.
273105: Shiori is Jirou Yakuin's classmate and childhood friend (and crush). She was paired with Minami Tenjin in their school's couples training. She is a kind and gentle girl, but she isn't very confident in herself and has a shy demeanor.
273109: Sadaharu is a close friend of Jirou Yakuin, being one of the few people Jirou is comfortable being open around. He is paired with Satsuki Kaneyama in their school's Marriage Practical.
273110: Considered to be the most popular student at Seishun Academy, Minami Tenjin is Shiori Sakurazaka's partner in the Marriage Practical and Akari Watanabe's crush. He works at a café together with Shuu Terafune and Keiichiro Kamo.
286617: She is a friend of Akari Watanabe alongside Natsumi Ōhashi
286618: She is a friend of Akari Watanabe alongside Sachi Takamiya
286619: The overprotective friend of Shiori Sakurazaka and the assigned practice partner of Shuu Terafune. She is extremely supportive of Shiori and pushes her to get together with their childhood crush Jirou Yakuin, despite her secretly having a crush on Shiori herself.
286620: He is the assigned practice partner of Mei Hamano, a friend/coworker of Minami Tenjin, and the self-declared rival of Jirou Yakuin for Akari Watanabe's affection. Shuu is generally portrayed as a self-absorbed, conceited, and presumptuous young man.
